session.title: DSM session
session.denied: The DSM session or current access permission could not be confirmed.
session.unavailable: The session could not be checked. Application data remains hidden.
probe.title: Stored scan data
probe.description: Select a profile, start a scan and open indexed files in File Station.
probe.truncated: Truncated list: at most 200 entries are shown. This table is not a total.
probe.name: Name and relative path
probe.stale: The mapping changed. Reload the snapshot.
probe.error: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and retry.
probe.complete: Full scan completed. A new snapshot is available; an already open view remains unchanged.
probe.partial: Scan has coverage gaps. An existing complete snapshot remains displayed.
probe.failed: The scan did not finish successfully. Existing snapshots are preserved.
probe.openRequested: Folder request sent to File Station. Check the opened path there.
probe.noSnapshot: No complete snapshot exists for this profile yet.
scan.interruptedHelp: Run interrupted. Start a new scan when needed. Working data may remain; seamless continuation is not available.
help.title: How to use DiskMap
help.window: Open We.Rock.DiskMap from the DSM main menu. Drag the title bar to move the window and its edge to resize it. Closing and reopening the window does not stop a scan that has already started.
help.scan: Choose a profile and explicitly start an initial full scan, a complete rebuild or “Update now”. All three check metadata throughout the profile scope. “Load snapshot” only opens stored results. Scanning continues in the background when you close the window.
help.fileStation: The action opens the parent folder of a file or the selected folder. Automatic file highlighting is not guaranteed. Use the displayed filename to locate the file in the opened folder.
help.session: The app uses your existing DSM login. Scans and stored results belong exclusively to your account. If the session expires, “Sign in to DSM” opens the DSM login. Do not enter credentials into scan profiles.
help.measurement: File size and reported allocation are different measurements. Unknown means no reliable value is available. Reported allocation is not a guarantee of space recovered by deletion; truncated lists do not represent totals.
probe.rebind: The profile source has changed. Its source mapping must be confirmed again before the next access.
probe.reindex: This index needs to be refreshed with a new full scan.
probe.pathEncoding: This path cannot be passed safely to File Station because its character encoding is unsupported.
probe.removedParent: The file is no longer present. You can open its surviving parent folder.
probe.fileStationUnavailable: This area is not directly available in File Station.
probe.launcherBuild: Opening File Station has not been verified for this DSM version and is unavailable.
probe.launcherUnavailable: The File Station window connection is unavailable. Reopen DiskMap from the DSM desktop.
probe.launcherFailed: The folder could not be passed to File Station. Please try again.
probe.parentRequested: Opening the parent folder was requested. The file is not highlighted automatically; find it there by its name. Check the opened folder in File Station.
paths.title: Name and paths
paths.name: File name from snapshot
paths.snapshotNotice: The NAS path comes from the selected scan. It does not confirm that the object still exists there.
paths.currentNotice: A File Station path is shown only after checking the current target.
paths.escaped: The original bytes cannot be fully represented as Unicode. This is escaped text, not a directly usable filesystem path.
paths.copyFailed: Copying was denied or is unavailable. You can select the text in the field and copy it yourself.
snapshot.profileChanged: Profile changed – the displayed scan snapshot uses the previous configuration.
node.hardlink: Hard link: this file has multiple path references. Path totals count every recorded path; this is not exclusive storage usage.
node.symlink: The link target is not followed and its size is not counted.
node.special: Special object: no file contents opened and no payload size assigned.
node.recycle: Recognized recycle-bin name; included where readable. The name alone does not establish system identity.
node.eaDir: Recognized name for Synology auxiliary data; included where readable. The name alone does not establish system identity.
node.pathSums: Path totals count hard-link references at every recorded path. An inode number alone does not identify a file across volumes.
node.reflink: Shared blocks, including Btrfs reflinks, are not measured exclusively here. Reported allocation does not promise how much space deleting a file will free.
storage.title: DiskMap storage usage
storage.separate: Current measurement of DiskMap index and working data. This value is separate from the selected scan and is not added to its file totals.
storage.partial: DiskMap storage usage measured partially. Displayed values may be incomplete.
storage.unavailable: DiskMap storage usage is currently unavailable. Unknown values do not mean zero bytes.
boundary.title: Scan boundaries in this snapshot
boundary.truncated: Truncated scan-boundary list. The count above includes all recorded boundaries.
boundary.package: DiskMap working data excluded from recursive scanning
boundary.mount: Mount outside the scan scope not entered
boundary.snapshot: Snapshot tree excluded from current-file scanning
boundary.unclassified: Subvolume could not be classified safely; area not scanned recursively
boundary.latestTitle: Boundaries of the latest loaded scan result
boundary.separate: These boundaries belong to the job shown above. The displayed file list may still come from an older complete snapshot.
boundary.latestUnavailable: The boundaries of the latest scan result could not be verified. This does not mean that no boundaries exist.
boundary.records: The count refers to stored boundary and gap records, not individual error events.
boundary.liveSources: Source data may change during a scan. A scan is not a consistent backup. Unrecorded areas do not mean zero bytes.
boundary.package.help: DiskMap usage is measured separately. Its working data is not scanned recursively.
boundary.mount.help: Review the selected local volumes and shared folders. This mount was detected outside the authorized scope.
boundary.snapshot.help: Snapshot trees are outside the ordinary current-file view. This exclusion does not imply storage savings.
boundary.unclassified.help: Check the source in DSM. Without reliable classification this area remains incomplete.
boundary.unreadable.help: Check the DiskMap package user’s read permissions for this area in DSM. Grant only the required read access, then scan again.
boundary.missing.help: Check whether the selected target still exists. The missing area was not recorded as empty; scan again after resolving it.
boundary.transient.help: Access was temporarily disrupted. Check the source and repeat the scan once it is stably accessible.
boundary.changed.help: Check the current DSM and profile mapping before scanning again. This run does not confirm an unchanged source.
boundary.io.help: Check the affected volume’s health in DSM. This notice alone establishes neither the cause nor the amount of missing data.
boundary.locked.help: Unlock the shared folder in DSM if appropriate, then scan again. DiskMap does not request decryption keys.
boundary.notMounted.help: Check in DSM that the selected volume is mounted and accessible, then start a new scan.
boundary.unverified.help: Check the source and its mapping in DSM. An unconfirmed identity is not presented as a reliably accessible area.
boundary.depth.help: Deeper entries were not recorded. Review the directory structure and use a narrower scan profile if appropriate.
boundary.profileExcluded.help: The exclusion rules effective for this scan intentionally omit this area. Review the profile rules if you want to include it.
boundary.scopeChanged.help: Review the selected targets and their mount mapping. Repeat the scan after resolving the change; the original start manifest is retained.
boundary.scopeUnavailable.help: The scope could not be reliably rechecked at scan end. Check accessibility and repeat the scan.
scan.cost: All three scan modes inspect metadata across the entire profile scope and create a new snapshot. “Update now” also checks every directory; it does not read only changes.
scan.reloadOnly: “Load snapshot” reads stored results and does not start a filesystem reconciliation.
scan.retry: The request outcome has not yet been resolved. Retry the same scan mode with the same request
scan.deduplicated: The matching existing job is shown; no second scan was started.
scan.jobConflict: Another scan conflicts with this request. Wait for it to finish, then start the desired scan mode again.
scan.replayConflict: This request was already used with different content. Start the desired scan mode again.
snapshot.partialWarning: Partial scan snapshot: some areas are missing. Values have not been filled from other snapshots. Path and File Station actions are unavailable in this view.
snapshot.partialUnqualified: This older partial scan has no explicitly bound collection interval. Start a new scan to open partially collected data explicitly.
view.expired: This view has expired. Explicitly adopt an available snapshot to continue.
view.limit: Too many open views. Close other views or wait for them to expire.
view.available: A new complete snapshot is available. The open view remains unchanged.
view.ancestor: The selected path is missing. The nearest surviving parent was selected.
view.scopeUnavailable: The previous selection could not be safely mapped to the new scope.
scan.queueFull: The queue is full. Wait for a job to finish.
view.historicalActions: The stored view, selection and recorded path details remain usable. File Station actions check the selected view’s target against its current state; changed or unavailable targets are not opened without verification.
view.pending: The adoption response is still unresolved. Retry checks the same snapshot and selection.
control.cooperative: An in-flight filesystem operation must return first. Resume is available only within the current service run.
control.pausePending: Pause requested; the job is reaching its next safe checkpoint.
control.cancelPending: Cancellation requested; in-flight work is finishing safely.
control.accepted: Control request accepted. The job status shows its actual effect.
control.conflict: This control request is no longer available in the current job state.
shell.title: Storage analysis
shell.help.overview: Choose a profile and load its recorded snapshot. A scan updates metadata while preserving your NAS files. The list shows recorded entries, not a live filesystem view.
shell.help.profiles: Profiles define the scan scope. Create profiles and edit their settings. Saving starts no scan. Open selects a profile without starting a scan. Scheduled tasks use the immutable profile ID.
shell.help.status: This section shows the actual accepted job and its history. Pause and cancel apply to that job. The displayed snapshot may still come from an earlier run.
shell.help.settings: Retention and integrity checks affect DiskMap’s own data. They do not delete your NAS files. Service diagnostics can be requested when needed.
shell.rootsHint: Orientation from the loaded index entries. The list may show only a bounded selection.
shell.rootsEmpty: No roots are available in the loaded selection.
shell.selectHint: Select an entry in the list. Recorded path details can be opened separately.
shell.noSnapshotHelp: Start a scan for this profile. Recorded entries are required before storage can be analysed.
shell.noProfilesHelp: No scan profile has been configured. No scan starts without a defined scope. Profile creation will be provided by the setup and profile editor.
shell.profileFallback: The previously selected profile is no longer available. An existing profile was opened without starting a scan.
shell.profileListHint: Open an existing profile. Overlapping profiles are not added together as a storage total.
shell.inactiveHelp: This profile is inactive. Existing snapshots remain readable; new scans are disabled.
shell.noJob: No job is known for this profile yet.
shell.snapshotUnavailable: The snapshot is currently unavailable. Reload the recorded data.
